changes.title: Batch 26: phone layout tightened (YAML tools, menu, top strip removed); records
changes.detail:
Reported from a phone:

- YAML tools page: two cramped columns with names broken inside words. The page did not reflect its narrow flag, so the one-column rule never applied; the grid now goes by width. - The slim strip at the top that named the current page is no longer shown on a phone: the Pages button in the bottom bar does that job and each page has its own header. Its height is no longer reserved, which also removes the empty band above the menu's title. - The open menu on a phone has less space around its header, the Assist button and its groups.

Records: an activity tray entry was seen while running in build 113; the build 109 operating system image was booted in a virtual machine; no update was offered there because later operating system builds failed on an outside module host or were cancelled; two device checks closed by the owner's decision.
changes.detail_yue: 第 26 批：手機版執位。YAML 工具頁之前硬係逼兩欄，啲字斬到一截截，而家夠闊 先至分兩欄。頂嗰條「而家喺邊頁」嘅幼條攞走咗，下面個「頁面」掣已經做晒 呢份工；連帶選單頂嗰忽空位都冇埋。選單啲間距亦都收緊咗，唔使碌咁耐。
